description.zh: 实例名称，支持模糊查询。例如搜索**abc**的所有实例，则可能返回**abc**、**abcde**、**xyabc**、**xabcy**的所有实例。
description.en: The instance name. Fuzzy search is supported. For example, if you search for all instances matching **abc**, all instances named **abc**, **abcde**, **xyabc**, and **xabcy** may be returned.

description.zh:
实例版本类型。可选值：

- x-pack：商业版

- advanced/IS：增强版

- community：基础版
description.en:
The edition type of the instance. Valid values:

- x-pack: Commercial Edition

- advanced/IS: Enhanced Edition

- community: Basic Edition

description.zh:
实例列表的页码。
起始值：**1**，默认值：**1**。
description.en:
The page number of the instance list.
Start value: **1**, default value: **1**.

description.zh:
实例的付费类型。可选值：

- postpaid：按量付费

- prepaid：包年包月
description.en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- postpaid: pay-as-you-go

- prepaid: subscription
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页条数。最大值：**100**，默认值：**10**。
description.en: The number of entries per page for paginated queries. Maximum value: **100**, default value: **10**.
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the instance is deployed.
The zone ID of the instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun elasticsearch list-instance --page 1 --size 10 --description aliyunes_test1 --instance-id es-cn-v641a0ta3000g0000 --es-version 6.7_with_X-Pack --resource-group-id rg-aekzvowej3i0000 --tags tagKey_:_key1_,_tagValue_:_value1 --vpc-id vpc-bp16k1dvzxtmagcva0000 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-i --payment-type postpaid --instance-category advanced --status example-string --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
